instruction: Candid wide shot of a group of friends celebrating on a rooftop terrace in daylight. From left to right, the man with a man-bun (R5) in a black shirt and the bald man with glasses (R6) in a white t-shirt dance happily. Beside them, the blonde woman (R1) in a colorful striped jumpsuit claps, while the man in a white cap (R2) stands in the center holding a small cupcake. To the right, the woman with tied-back hair (R4) in a black top laughs, next to the dark-haired woman (R3) in a striped top and the woman with a curly afro (R7) in a striped dress who look on smiling. The group interacts joyfully against a modern white building background under bright, natural light.
